content.title: About this demonstration
content.body: This tool supports self-monitoring and does not diagnose any condition. Rules, personal ranges and levels are team proposals, not medical criteria. Mood and stress are meant for the astronaut and the Crew Medical Officer; this local API does not enforce access control yet.

indicatorDefinitions.label: PVT-B mean speed
indicatorDefinitions.description: Mean of 1/RT, with RT in seconds, calculated on the server by pvt-sessions from times measured in the browser with performance.now(). It is not 1/mean(RT). False starts (under 100 ms or a tap without stimulus) are excluded; a 30 s timeout counts as an RT of 30 s. Interrupted sessions or sessions without valid responses are audited without creating indicators; legacy aggregates are still accepted.

content.title: About this demonstration
content.body: CO₂, oxygen, pressure, temperature, humidity and noise describe the cabin. Personal reports are shown next to them, without inferring a cause. Each limit is marked as NASA or as a prototype simplification.

content.title: How to use it
content.body: Follow your mission's approved procedure. This demonstration describes records and does not give individual medical advice.
